summary.text: Eric Stafford is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Janae Shamp.
According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Phoenix and his career experience includes working as a machinist, vet tech and political organizer.

paragraphs.text: Stafford graduated from the Western Maricopa Education Center in 2016 and from the Pima Medical Institute in 2018, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Goodyear, attended public schools, and studied aviation maintenance and machining in technical school before training as a vet tech.
Stafford said in the 2024 survey that he worked as a field organizer in Legislative Districts 14 and 15 in 2022.
In that survey he named education and labor among his campaign priorities.
